title: Plain G1 ECDLP: (4,3) CM-STNFS over Q(zeta_15) with tiled Arch2-Rev-SigmaB behind a run gate: expected work 2^112.832352798025

claims.statement: For the full production bls12-381-g1-ecdlp-plain target, the algorithm of proof.md (with field-map.md, DESCENT.md, KERNELS.md, STORAGE.md) returns scalar x in 0..r-1 from T=[x]P0 via g=e(P0,Q0), z=e(T,Q0)=g^x with fresh-coin boot randomization with success at least 0.39 over uniform challenges and fresh coins, under heuristics H1, H1', H-EA, H-FFT, H2, H3, H-SM, H4, H4u, H-X and H5 (with explicit de Bruijn local-density correction in both collection and descent), at expected total classical work at most 1+(K/2^64) x 10 x (2^110.8653137017+2^66) < 2^112.832352798025 batched affine G1 additions (C=2,000; 1 core unit = 10 G1 units): an expectation over the challenge and the coins of the one attack on the one target, not a bound on every run. A run gate (u < K = 7212029477497188191, (K/2^64) x 0.997532 >= 0.39) precedes an opened run that succeeds with probability at least 0.997532 (strict additive union bound) and costs at most 2^118.974963720588 units. Nothing is amortized. Analytic exploratory claim.

experiments.purpose: Hosted pure-stdlib audit: exact BLS12-381 Q(zeta_15) w'=omega^2 algebra, Frobenius, and live Rabin mod-r CRT (f:[36,36], g:[4,4,4,12]), live E2E (4,3) split-base tower DLP (BSGS + CRT SM + 5/5 unseen targets + neg controls), live D_(omega,sigma) 239/239 exact-1 & Arch2-Rev-SigmaB 48-ideal exactness, 12 integer anchor norms, SRT toy, live Euler-product Retention + 16D tiled ellipsoid integral + Band-1 integral + ECM Chebyshev (<2^-77), 2^16..2^23 filtsim_z12 + exact k5 + full 1-owner Arch B LA RAM, live 78-node bottom-up descent recurrence + boot, 80-digit Decimal strict additive union bound/gate/manifest check, and inline Z[zeta_12] H-X smoke check.
On-demand H-R & H-X check over Z[zeta_12] mod 1,000,033 with 4 dense Schirokauer columns and block-diagonal X (verifying full rank C_d = N, O_e A = D, and -3 rank drop on 1-block pad control).
